title: Calderano and Diaz win singles titles as Americas Championships honours are shared
standfirst: Hugo Calderano beat his Brazilian teammate Guilherme Teodoro and Adriana Diaz beat Canada's Mo Zhang in Lima, where no country won more than two titles.
body: Hugo Calderano won the men's singles title at the ITTF-Americas Championships in Lima, beating his Brazilian teammate Guilherme Teodoro 4-1 in the final. Puerto Rico's Adriana Diaz took the women's title with a 4-2 win over Canada's Mo Zhang.

Calderano, the world No 7 and the only player from the Americas in the men's top 10, was the favourite. The rest of the week was harder to call, with titles going to Brazil, Puerto Rico, Canada, Chile and the US.
The US women were the strongest team. They beat Guatemala 3-0 and Canada 3-1, then swept Puerto Rico 3-0 in the final.

Chile's Nicolas Burgos and Gustavo Gomez won the men's doubles, beating Venezuela's Medina and Rios 3-0. Brazil's Giulia Takahashi and Laura Watanabe took the women's doubles with a 3-0 win over the Americans Sally Moyland and Lily Zhang.
Mo Zhang still left Lima with a title. She and Edward Ly won the mixed doubles for Canada, beating Teodoro and Takahashi 3-0 and denying Teodoro a second title.
The result of the men's team final is unclear. Butterfly's headline credits Venezuela, while its match report says Argentina beat Brazil 3-2. This story will be updated when the result is confirmed.
The WTT tour moves to Europe next, with WTT Champions Montpellier and WTT Champions Frankfurt over the next fortnight.
